“Whether it's data centers or artificial intelligence, I wanna make sure that there are guardrails in place so that technology works for humans, not the other way around.” 

Colorado congressional candidate (D) Manny Rutinel talks to Vox’s Astead Herndon about the role data centers and AI play in his campaign. Watch this week’s episode of America, Actually here on YouTube or listen wherever you get your podcasts on Saturday.
